summary: At an August 2026 GOP primary debate in NH-01, DiLorenzo stated, “I do support Israel,” while adding that military funding should carry humanitarian conditions. His campaign platform separately lists support for “peace efforts, particularly in the Middle East and Ukraine” as a foreign-policy priority, but the debate remark anchors his position in explicit support for Israel with a modest humanitarian qualifier rather than any specific accountability for Israeli military conduct.
